name: Onchain Router
description: Use policy-bounded, receipt-backed LLM calls through the local AgenticFI Buyer Runtime.

proxyOrigin.description: Loopback origin of the separately running Onchain Router buyer proxy.

tokenFile.description: Owner-only file containing the buyer proxy bearer. Defaults to ~/.onchain-router/proxy-token.

profileDirectory.description: Buyer profile directory. Defaults to the directory containing tokenFile.

manageProxy.description: Start the exact installed loopback proxy when it is not already reachable.
